'''Grim Tooth''' was a [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] kept in a containment cell at the [[Sanctuary research complex]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]]<ref name="Makeb" /> in [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Grim Tooth was [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="Makeb" />
{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Grim Tooth appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on Makeb. He is not directly involved in any quests, but can be killed for loot and as part of an achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
